QUOTE: "MSVC or any non-GNU compiler | C fallback (`MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` needs `__GNUC__`)"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer mentions MBEDTLS_CT_ASM only in passing, as needing `__GNUC__`. It never says the macro is derived rather than configured, and it doesn't say it is set from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros instead of from an mbedtls_config.h entry.
